text:
Pegasus Constellation-λ, this strange planet’s orbit is unpredictable, and its inhabitants sometimes gaze into the void and act nonsensically. The company sent agents to investigate, but always received absurd responses: 'Because, *I* did it.' Eventually, the Knowledge Society discovered from the crystalline core of this world the influence of 'Balance' on fate, and posed the right question:
『Where is your *I*?』
『Here, and there.』
People point to themselves, and to the universe beyond, the nonexistent center of mass, extending into the distant void...

『...They can never enter the destruction conclusion of the binary star system, after all, they cannot embrace each other.』
